rationale: The only behavioral delta is the storage bound and increment: the vulnerable version increments len even when no space remains and stores only when len < MAXWORDLEN-1, whereas the fixed version stores and increments only when len < MAXWORDLEN. The Logic sentence stating that the resulting character is stored "if there is space available" is an abstract description compatible with both versions and does not specify either threshold or whether len advances when storage is unavailable. All other stated escape-processing behavior is shared by both implementations.
